sentences.text: MR DK MODI(1317) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR KI SHAH(766) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 MR JK SHAH, APP for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 ====================================

=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018
ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri JK Shah appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.

Today, Mr. D. K. Patel, Food Safety Officer (I Card No. 14787)from the Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat is present before the Court and states that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court and if the applicant is ready and willing to deposit the amount of fine, let the matter be disposed of.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.

As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that R/CR.RA/90/2016 ORDER the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

Case No. 2 of 2003, which was confirmed by the learned 9th Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 47 of 2008 dated 27.01.2016 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
